# Data Source: identitynow_source_schedule

Use this data source to look up an aggregation schedule of a source by type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_source_schedule" "account_aggregation" {
  source_id = "2c9180835d191a86015d28455b4a2329"
  type      = "ACCOUNT_AGGREGATION"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source_id` (String) ID of the source.
- `type` (String) Schedule type, `ACCOUNT_AGGREGATION` or `GROUP_AGGREGATION`.

### Read-Only

- `cron_expression` (String) Cron expression of the schedule.
- `id` (String) ID in the format `<source_id>/<type>`.
